description: Visual quality canon defining acceptance and rejection criteria for static images.

quality_dimensions.name: Sharpness
quality_dimensions.description: Image edges and fine details must be crisp and well-defined.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: No visible blur in subject focal areas. Texture detail readable at 100% zoom.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Subject focal area shows motion blur, defocus, or compression artifacts masking detail.

quality_dimensions.name: Anatomy Correctness
quality_dimensions.description: Human and creature anatomy must be physically plausible.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Correct limb count, joint placement, and proportions. Hands have 5 fingers with natural spacing.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Extra limbs, fused fingers, impossible joints, or gross proportion errors.

quality_dimensions.name: Face Integrity
quality_dimensions.description: Face must be natural, symmetric within human variance, and identity-consistent.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Eyes match in gaze and shape. Mouth and teeth are natural. No distortion.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Mismatched eyes, distorted mouth, bad teeth, or face warping.

quality_dimensions.name: Identity Fidelity
quality_dimensions.description: Character identity must match the approved reference within acceptable drift.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Character is recognizable as the approved reference. Key traits preserved.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Character appears as a different person or core identity traits are lost.

quality_dimensions.name: Style Adherence
quality_dimensions.description: Visual style must match the approved style guide.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Style matches brief and reference images (photoreal, painterly, etc.).
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Style drifts into unapproved territory (anime, cartoon, stock-photo look when not requested).

quality_dimensions.name: Composition
quality_dimensions.description: Shot framing and subject placement must follow director intent.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Subject properly framed. Head not cropped unless intentional. Rule of thirds respected.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Bad framing, unintended cropping, subject too small or off-center without reason.

quality_dimensions.name: Color Accuracy
quality_dimensions.description: Color palette must align with approved color script.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Dominant colors match color script. No unintended color casts.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Severe color shift that contradicts mood or continuity.

quality_dimensions.name: Lighting Consistency
quality_dimensions.description: Light direction, quality, and mood must be consistent within the scene.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Light source direction consistent. Shadows plausible. Mood matches scene.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Conflicting light sources, impossible shadows, or mood-breaking lighting errors.
